summary: First iteration testing of LotePro (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed covering auth, lotes seed, PIX EMV payload, deposits flow (create→admin approve→balance credit), withdrawals (reserve→reject refund / approve), buy lote (balance debit & purchase), yield computation + collect, admin CRUD for lotes, admin PIX update, admin guards (403 for users). Frontend: login/register/home/loja/deposito(QR+Já paguei)/perfil/admin(depósitos,saques,lotes,usuários,pix)/sobre screens all render correctly on mobile viewport (390x844), admin badge + Painel Administrativo link appears only for admin role, deposit POST creates a pending record verified end-to-end through the UI and via admin panel. Admin credentials ggc@gmail.com / @N1collas work and are auto-seeded on startup.

ui_bugs.issue: Empty-state text reads 'Nenhum depósito pending.' (mixed pt-BR/en). Should be 'Nenhum depósito pendente.' Likely same for saques/other tabs.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props, 'resizeMode' style, 'props.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic, not blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow/props.resizeMode/style.pointerEvents over time.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo doctor warns: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0), expo-clipboard@55.0.13 (~8.0.8), expo-image-picker@55.0.19 (~17.0.10), expo-secure-store@55.0.13 (~15.0.8), react-native-svg@15.15.4 (15.12.1). App currently works, but upgrade/downgrade may be advised for stability.

action_items: (LOW) Fix pt-BR empty-state string 'Nenhum depósito pending.' -> 'Nenhum depósito pendente.' in admin/depositos.tsx (and double-check admin/saques.tsx).
(LOW) Address React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, resizeMode, pointerEvents) — not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI — prefer lifespan context manager. Not breaking.

CORS allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=False is correct for Bearer-token auth, but cookies set via /auth/login/register would be non-functional across origins (app primarily uses Bearer header storage on the client, so this is fine).

compute_lote_yield / user_accumulated_yield iterate purchases sequentially with an await db.lotes.find_one per purchase; acceptable for small N but O(N) DB reads per /api/me/lotes or /api/wallet call — could cache lotes dict.
server.py is ~725 lines; borderline against >700 rule — consider splitting (auth, lotes, deposits, withdrawals, admin) into routers.
sanitize_user / explicit _id exclusion is consistently applied. UUID ids used. Good.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified; only a minor pt-BR typo found)

seed_data_creation: Did not create manual seeds; the 3 lotes (Lote PC / Cofre Prata / Ouro Puro) were already seeded via curl by main agent. Tests register TEST_* users which remain in DB but are harmless (emails prefixed TEST_ / depfix... for cleanup identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL = https://lotes-gestao.preview.emergentagent.com (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Admin ggc@gmail.com/@N1collas auto-seeded on startup. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers the happy paths end-to-end. For UI tests of deposit/withdraw confirmations, use testIDs (deposit-confirm, deposit-amount-input, quick-30, etc.) — do NOT rely on `text=Já paguei` because React Native Alert confirmation dialogs intercept. All admin screens reachable at /admin/{depositos,saques,lotes,usuarios,pix} and are gated by role=admin in the UI.
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs encountered. One test-only issue: `page.click('text=Já paguei')` sometimes does not trigger the onPress on React Native Web TouchableOpacity because the text node is nested inside a View. Using the testID `deposit-confirm` resolved this. Root cause: RN Web maps TouchableOpacity -> div, text -> span; click target matters.
